programme.title: Key & Peele: East West Bowl #2
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en introdukjson av de nyeste East/West Bowl-spillerne, utleier-Devon ransaker Jordans leilighet, og Jordan blir støtt av en overseksuell kollega.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery
programme.desc: En baseballspiller slåss med sin avhengighet av rumpeklapsing, en mafioso tar hevn og Steve Urkel driver en mann til vanvidd.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Manly Tears
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en narkohandel som går på trynet, en mafiafyr som er en stor grinasabb, og Darius Rucker som prøver å takle sin Hootie-fortid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dueling Magical Negroes
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan spiller to mystikere som kjemper om rettigheten til å gi skarpsindige råd. Andre sketsjer inkluderer Jaden Smith og hans agent som diskuterer et nytt manuskript, og et homsepar som 'feirer' ny lovgivning.

programme.title: Key & Peele: I'm Retired
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en ungkars-fest som blir underlig og en svart fyr med en hvit penis.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Job Interview
programme.desc: Dommer Jessie har et nytt program, en mann venter på et jobbintervju, to damer sludrer, parkeringsvakter diskuterer Val Kilmer, en pensjonert mann fra hæren hører om et nytt prosjekt og en kvinne introduserer sin forlovede for foreldrene.

programme.title: Key & Peele: A Cappella Club
programme.desc: En PSA jobber med barnesoldater i Afrika, en college-a-cappella-gruppe får et nytt medlem, Meegan og André går på sin første date, en terrorgruppe har en matbil og to gamle menn diskuterer popmusikk.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Biological Dad
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer et romvesen som lærer om kvinnelig anatomi, karer som prøver å overgå hverandre og møtet mellom de to siste mennesker på Jorden.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Soul Food
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer hvem som er mest svart, og å være den eneste svarte på en fest. Sketsjer inkluderer Tea Party som oppdager et nytt håp, hærens ververe som tenker annerledes, og Bobby McFerrin som duellerer mot Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Parole Officer Puppet
programme.desc: En tilsynsverge bruker en dukke til å knytte bånd til en person i hans varetekt, en mann med nakkestøtte prøver å feste villt og en soldat har en følelsesladet gjenforening med familien sin.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Killer Concept Album
programme.desc: En politiker benekter å ha sendt rampete bilder, en detektiv forhører en rapper, Cedric og Levi finner lyn i en flaske, to herrer fra sør komplimenterer kvinner, Jordan møter en gammel venn og en betjent tar tingene helt bokstavelig.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Concussion Quarterback
programme.desc: En fotballspiller med hjerneskade prøver å inspirere laget sitt, en mann anklager sin kone for å være utro med en hund og en restauranteier skremmer bort gjestene sine.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Alien Imposters
programme.desc: Romvesener invaderer jorden, en familie forliker seg med en slektnings homobryllup og noen rasister gir uttrykk for noen overraskende meninger.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrorist Meeting
programme.desc: En gangster prøver desperat å bevise at han er gal, terrorister møtes for å planlegge sitt neste trekk og en sjalu storebror gjør familiemiddagen pinlig.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer at kara har en dårlig Skype-forbindelse, en Django Unchained-slavekamp og en baseballspiller som klasker for mange rumper.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Black Ice News
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer Samuel og Lashawn som gleder seg over fordelene ved sine nå lovlige ekteskap, en politibetjent som møter sin nye makker og Lando fra 'Star Wars' blir forfulgt av et superfan.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Addict Wendel
programme.desc: Artister blir sparket i skrittet på grunn av kunsten sin, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mann prøver å få hellet med seg på et møte for sexmisbrukere.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The 420 Special
programme.desc: Neil deGrasse Tyson slapper av hjemme, Keegan må bevare fatningen under et jobbintervju, en skredder får en klient med luft i magen, parkeringsvaktene diskuterer 'Game of Thrones' og en telefonselger prøver en ny strategi.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Airplane Showdown
programme.desc: En flyvert må håndtere en passasjer som ikke vil ha på sikkerhetsbeltet, britiske oppdagelsesreisende diskuterer sine reiser, to par forsøker å unngå spoilere på en dobbeltdate og en bibelgruppe opplever en guddommelig intervensjon.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor
programme.desc: Kileleking mellem to venner blir plutselig merkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistenker vennen sin for å stjele og Keegan og Jordan diskuterer Afrika på en fest.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The End
programme.desc: Ray Parker Jr. har noen nye låter, en mann kan ikke slutte å si "deez nuts", Keegan må ringe 112 og en ung mann lærer om Negrotown.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dubstep
programme.desc: President Obama og hans vredeoversetter, Luther, taler til Mitt Romney, vi møter mannen som skulle holde tale etter Martin Luther Kings 'I Have A Dream'-tale, og to venner prater om hva som skjer med bæsjen deres atter at de skyller ned.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Non-Stop Party
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en fyr som jager etter kjæresten sin til verdens ende og LMFAO som ikke kan holde opp med å feste.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MMMMMM
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan opptrer foran et oppstemt publikum, en trafikkreporter blir utsatt for turbulens i et helikopter og halvdelen av en R&B duo avslører sine sanne følelser for sin partner under en opptreden.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Das Negroes
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan prøver å gjemme seg for en negerjaktende nazist. Andre sketsjer inkluderer to slaver som sliter med å bli solgt, et par kriminelle som kommer i knipe før et stort kupp.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Aerobics Meltdown
programme.desc: Stan Lee har noen nye superhelter, og en gatesmart fyr mister sin street cred når han opplever en hjernefrysning. Og sist, men ikke minst, utvikler en mann en komplisert minnesanordning for å huske hvor han har parkert.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Flicker
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan har en flickerkamp og en MMA-fighter går for langt når han erter motstanderen. Andre sketsjer inkluderer en bryllupsgjest somvil være dj og spille "klassiske" låter.

programme.title: Key & Peele: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer All-Stars fra East/West bowl som rapper, karene spiller mafioso og de to parkeringstypene har vanskelig for å tro at noen tør å provosere Batmans.
programme.sub-title: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap

programme.title: Key & Peele: Severed Head Showcase
programme.desc: En gospel-gruppe må øve uten læreren sin, en gjeng krigere feirer en halshugning, en fange prøver å narre fengselsvakten og en ung mann blir konfrontert fordi han bare snakker i floskler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meagan's Fight
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer at Meagan vender tilbake, Jordan prøver å se kul ut på en strippeklubb og opptrer med et funk-show.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Detective
programme.desc: En respektert kriminalbetjent, ekspert i sexforbrytelser, benytter ukonvensjonelle metoder for å løse en sak, en actionhelt redder kjæresten sin og en ansatt i en butikk med yoghurt-is tester for mange vareprøver.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sexy Vampires
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en uhyggelig asiatisk spøkelsessamboer, kara ser på den lyse siden av tortur og Keegan opplever et hus fullt av sexy vampyrer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
programme.desc: Inkluderer sketsjer der Keegan og Jordan avlytter hvite kvinner som elsker svarte menn, Wendell lager en musikkvideo og Kareem og Jahar går på treningssenteret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Gang Stand-Off
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer gangstere som er gale etter 'Twilight,' besøk i en verden der navn er promper, og rasistiske superhelter.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrible Henchman
programme.desc: En nødsituasjon tvinger en mann til å endre morgenritualet sitt, en medforbryter ødelegger for superskurken og Jordan minner Keegan på at han er voksen nå.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bitch
programme.desc: I denne seriepremierer av komiprogrammet prøver Jordan Peele og Keegan Michael Key å si et forbudt ord om deres kvinner, Lil Wayne venner seg til livet bak lås og slå, og president Obama uttrykker hva han egentlig føler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Landlord
programme.desc: I sesongfinalen vil president Obama behandles som alle andre, Jordan ser på en leilighet som er eid av en mistenksom utleier, og et par festfiksere som vil få gang i festen på en bar mitzvah.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Boarding Group One
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer at Keegan ikke får lov å gå om bord i flyet sitt, en bølle som nekter å helle ut innholdet i spritflaska og en bokser som sviner til modstanderen sin.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Joke Stealing
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en fotballspiller som blir straffet for å juble for mye, Jordan og Keegan som går på premieren på "Othello" og en high school-elev som blir berømt for å stjele en vits.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Country Music
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer Steve Jobs' efterfølger, Ice-T, som en uoppdragen valp og Rihanna og Chris Brown prøver igjen.

programme.title: Broad City: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana drar til Philly for å besøke Abbis barndomshjem . Når Abbi innser at hun gjorde en stor tabbe på videregående, drar hun og Ilana på forsoningsoppdrag.

programme.title: Broad City: B&B-NYC
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana legger ut leilighetene sine på B & B-NYC for å tjene litt ekstra penger.

programme.title: Broad City: Burning Bridges
programme.desc: Ilanas foreldre kommer til byen for deres 30-årsjubileum, men Abbi og Ilana syns det er vanskelig å feire når de begge opplever samlivsproblemer.

programme.title: Broad City: Getting There
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana skal ut på tur, men bare det å komme seg til flyplassen viser seg å være mye vanskeligere enn forventet.

programme.title: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
programme.desc: Abbi får mensen under en flytur, så hun og Ilana går drastisk til verks for å finne en tampong.

programme.title: Broad City: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: En vårdag i 2011 møtes Abbi og Ilana for første gang.

programme.title: Broad City: Twaining Day
programme.desc: Abbis korte tilbakekomst til Soulstice blir interessant når hun får opplæringsmuligheten som hun alltid har drømt om. I mellomtiden får Ilana en ny jobb på en restaurant.

programme.title: Broad City: Just the Tips
programme.desc: Ilana går amok med pengene hun tjente på servitørjobben, og Abbis nye forhold gjør at det lyser av henne. På fest senere den kvelden, møter jentene på en gammel venn.

programme.title: Broad City: Mushrooms
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana ruser seg på sopp og opplever en hendelsesrik trip.

programme.title: Broad City: Abbi's Mom
programme.desc: Abbis mor kommer til byen på besøk, og Ilana navigerer Sushi Mambeaux' intense arbeidskultur samtidig som hun håndterer sin sesongavhengig depresjon.

programme.title: Broad City: Witches
programme.desc: Abbi føler seg gammel etter å ha funnet et grått hår; Ilana går til en sexterapeut.

programme.title: Broad City: Florida
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Eliot og Bobbi drar til Florida for å rydde ut av Grandma Esthers leilighet.

programme.title: Broad City: House Sitting
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Jaime og Lincoln passer huset til Strands. Ilana og Lincoln definerer forholdet deres, og Abbi går på en Bumble-date med en mann fra fortiden hennes.

programme.title: Broad City: Bed Bugs
programme.desc: En fancy ny veske gir Abbi tillit under arbeidsledigheten. Ilana og Jaimé må ta tak i et uunngåelig New York City-mareritt.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Jentenes 'Friendiversary' utvikler seg i en farlig retning når de blir vitne til noe forferdelig.

programme.title: Broad City: Stories
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana farer fra toppen av Manhattan til bunnen for å feire Abbis 30-årsdag, og treffer på både gamle og nye venner på veien.

programme.title: Broad City: Shework and S**t Bucket
programme.desc: Ilana gir seg i kast med sin seneste mulighet til å tjene penger da hun en åpner et utendørs kontorlandskap for New Yorks røykere; Abbi konfronterer husverten sin da han nekter å modernisere sanitæranlegget hennes.

programme.title: Broad City: Bitcoin & the Missing Girl
programme.desc: Ilana besøker en gammel flamme for å få sin del av en Bitcoin-formue; Abbi glemmer klesvasken sin for første gang, og mister favorittgenseren sin.

programme.title: Broad City: Make the Space
programme.desc: Ilana oppdager en skremmende hemmelighet om Jaimé; Abbi prøver å avansere fra genserbretter til vinduskunstner på Anthropologie.

programme.title: Broad City: Artsy Fartsy
programme.desc: Abbi inviteres til et fancy kunstarrangement på MoMA; Ilana og Lincoln analyserer det første året de har vært sammen.

programme.title: Broad City: Lost and Found
programme.desc: Jentene møter Ilanas femtenmenning, som overlevde Holocaust, og tar ham med på en kjedelig brunch; Abbi prøver en ny look.

programme.title: Broad City: Shenanigans
programme.desc: Ilana rekrutteres som hårmodell; Abbis nye flamme forteller henne at hun ikke er moden nok.

programme.title: Broad City: Sleep No More
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana besøker 'Sleep No More', og Abbi prøver å finne rett tidspunkt for å fortelle Ilana noe som vil forandre livet hennes radikalt.

programme.title: Broad City: Along Came Molly
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana og Bevers selger Abbis eiendeler i New York; Abbi får billetter til en Lil Wayne-konsert, og jentene tar en 'tripp'.

programme.title: Broad City: Broad City
programme.desc: Jentene tar farvel.

programme.title: Broad City: What A Wonderful World
programme.desc: Ilana får nyss om en hemmelig Lil Wayne-konsert. Sammen med Abbi loffer hun seg frem i New York. Jentene lar ingenting hindre dem i å skrape sammen nok penger til billettene. Selv om det blir skremmende, mister de aldri målet av sikte.

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone
programme.desc: Etter å ha prøvd å finne gutter på Facebook, bestemmer Abbi og Ilana seg for å prøve å finne gutter i 'virkeligheten'.

programme.title: Broad City: Working Girls
programme.desc: Ilana prøver å tjene litt ekstra penger i 'temp game'. Abbi lover naboen sin å vente på pakken hans, men hun går glipp av leveransen og må dra til verdens ende for å få fatt i den.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: Når Abbi får sprøytet leiligheten sin mot skadedyr og Ilana mister nøklene sine, blir jentene nødt til å bo på gaten - akkurat når Abbi har sin første kunstutstilling.

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed
programme.desc: Jentene må bli voksne! Abbi vil kjøpe sin egen marihuana, som en voksen kvinne, mens Ilana må takle skatten på egen hånd. Og, jentene er høye som hus.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: Når Abbi innser at hun er for snill, blir hun mere bitchy. Ilana bestemmer seg for å nå sitt fulle potential. De går på en eksklusiv fest og møter noen eventyrlige DJ-er. Nå kan ingenting gå galt.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana klarer sig igennem stormen med hjælp fra deres venner (Jaimé, Lincoln og Jeremy), men de får desværre selskab af Bevers og hans søster. Et spil 'Who Done It?' udspiller sig, mens orkanan raser udenfor.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Ilana leter febrilsk etter en gave i siste øyeblikk til Lincoln, mens Abbi prøver å finne et klimaanlegg for å få det kjølig på soveværelset.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Der dukker opp nye muligheter når Abbi endelig kan trene noen på Soulstice og Ilana gjør suksess som firmasjef.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi skal trekke visdomstennene og Ilana ser det som sin plikt å passe henne til hun får det bedre - noe som selvfølgelig innebærer en masse 'medikamenter' og en total mangel på tilsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi og Jeremy går på en date som ender med en overraskelse. Ilana og hennes mor leter etter den perfekte håndvesken.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Jentene leter etter den perfekte fest, noe som avslører en underlig og surrealistisk side av Abbi, som igjen bekrefter Ilanas verste anelser.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Gjengen skal feire at Jaime har blitt amerikansk statsborger, men Bevers fører Abbi og Ilana på avveier med å love dem gratis sprit. Imens må Lincoln og Jaime klare seg selv blandt alle advokatene.

programme.title: Broad City: Coat Check
programme.desc: Abbi prøver å finne en forsvunnet frakk, mens Ilana utforsker en ny romanse - som føles merkelig kjent.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingelskeren
programme.desc: Barbrady ber guttene om hjelp til å løse en sak, og Cartman lar seg rive med av sin nye autoritet.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en analundersøkelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer at han møter et romvesen, men de andre guttene er sikre på at drømmen var virkelighet.

programme.title: South Park: En stige til himmelen
programme.desc: Guttene bryter seg inn for å stjele urnen med Kennys aske.

programme.desc: De hysteriske foreldrene i South Park får enda en grunn til panikk når 'cheesing' blir poplært blant barna.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny blir drept av en styrtende romstasjon og forvandlet til en zombie, ved hjelp av balsameringsvæske og Worcestersaus.

programme.title: South Park: Universets største drittsekk
programme.desc: Cartman føler seg ikke bra etter å ha drukket Kennys aske og blitt besatt av sjelen hans, og sendes til sykehuset.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny dør
programme.desc: Kenny utvikler en dødelig sykdom, og Stan har problemer med å takle det.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Dilla på apefonetikk
programme.desc: Guttene konkurrerer mot hjemmeunderviste barn i South Parks årlige stavekonkurranse.

programme.title: South Park: Bestevenner for alltid
programme.desc: Cartmans blir sjalu når Kenny får det siste nye bærbare spillet før lekebutikkene går tomme. Vil Cartman og Kenny kunne forbli bestevenner for alltid?

programme.title: South Park: Midtbyen
programme.desc: South Parks bykjerne holder på å oppgraderes og Kenny bestemmer bestemmer seg for at det er på tide å skaffe en jobb.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Etterpåklokskap
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbake og denne gangen har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans bestefar prøver å lure guttene til å drepe ham. Foreldrene i South Park prøver å få stanset sendingene av 'Terrance and Phillip'.

programme.title: South Park: Den fattige ungen
programme.desc: Kennys foreldre blir arrestert og han plasseres i fosterhjem - så nå er Cartman det fattigste barnet på skolen! I mellomtiden kommer en mystisk figur fra fortiden tilbake.

programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Kjærlighet, ikke Warcraft
programme.desc: Guttene har spilt World of Warcraft en hel helg da en annen spiller dreper dem uten tegn på anger.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med toeren på pissoaret
programme.desc: Cartman tror han vet hvem som står bak angrepene 11. september.

programme.title: South Park: Heia Gud
programme.desc: Cartman prøver å reise til fremtiden for å kjøpe et nytt dataspill.

programme.title: South Park: Heia Gud XII
programme.desc: Cartman fryser seg ned og våkner opp 500 år inn i fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: Lusningen
programme.desc: Cartman vil finne kilden til et luseutbrudd på skolen, så han kan gjøre narr av ham.

programme.title: South Park: De levende hjemløses natt
programme.desc: Uteliggere oversvømmer South Park, og guttene legger en lur plan for å flytte dem til en annen by, mens de voksne får panikk.

programme.title: South Park: Hyllusinasjoner
programme.desc: De hysteriske foreldrene i South Park får enda en grunn til panikk når 'cheesing' blir poplært blant barna.

programme.title: South Park: Utlogget
programme.desc: Forvirring og panikk råder da Internett blir borte i South Park!

programme.title: South Park: Pandemien
programme.desc: South Park tar en 'Cloverfield' med store, mystiske skapninger som herjer rundt i verden og blir fanget opp av Randys kamera.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemien 2: Alarmerende
programme.desc: Enorme marsvin angriper byer i hele verden. Guttene har nøkkelen til å redde menneskeheten, men sitter fast i Andesfjellene.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Kaptein Tjukkskjegg
programme.desc: Cartman har hørt om alle de rikdommene som blir plyndret av pirater i Somalia, så han setter en lapp over øyet og sleper gjengen med til Afrika for å få en bit av kaka.

programme.title: South Park: Tiss
programme.desc: Høyt urininnhold i svømmebassenget fører til en katastrofe som ødelegger guttas dag, særlig Kyles. Og Cartmans xenofobi får fritt utløp igjen.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Etterpåklokskap
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbake og denne gangen har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reiser seg
programme.desc: Ført an av 'Mysterion', jobber 'Coon' og vennene hans med å hjelpe folk i Gulfen. Og 'Coon' er ute etter hevn.

programme.title: South Park: Coon mot Coon og venner
programme.desc: 'The Coon' viser seg å være enda ondere en den mørke mesteren Cthulhu, når han krever hevn over sine tidligere partnere.

programme.title: South Park: Lattermaskinen
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt gjort narr av på The South Park Elementary Comedy Awards, bygger Germany en uovervinnerlig lattermaskin: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheten går likevel ikke altfor bra.

programme.title: South Park: Vulkanen
programme.desc: Guttene drar på jakt med Stans gale onkel Jimbo, uvitende om at fjellet de er på er en vulkan på nippet til å bryte ut.

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans bestefar prøver å lure guttene til å drepe ham. Foreldrene i South Park prøver å få stanset sendingene av 'Terrance and Phillip'.

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny blir drept av en styrtende romstasjon og forvandlet til en zombie, ved hjelp av balsameringsvæske og Worcestersaus.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny blir oppslukt av det siste nye fra Japan: Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Datakalenderen
programme.desc: Cartman skryter av sin nye Trapper Keeper, men en fremmed forteller ham at den snart vil ta over verden om de ikke ødelegger den nå.

programme.title: South Park: Det helsprø antastningseventyret

programme.title: South Park: Helvete bryter løs

programme.desc: Guttene er oppslukt av Stans nye spillkonsoll. Mens de spiller, begynner håndkledet Towelie å snakke til dem.

programme.desc: South Park blir oversvømmet av arbeidere fra fremtiden som jobber for lavere lønn. Mennene i South Park tyr til overraskende midler for å stoppe dem.

programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer
programme.desc: I 1945 ble verden ført inn i atomalderen. Rollen hans som "Father of the Bomb" var satt , og Oppenheimer ble stadig mer bekymret for den potensielle faren denne vitenskapelige oppfinnelser kunne utgjøre for menneskeheten.

programme.title: Secret War: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.desc: Monty Woodhouse, a professor and a legend for blowing up the Gorgopotamos Bridge in Greece in 1942. In the British counter attack against Rommell at Al Alamein in North Africa it was vital to disrupt German supply routes, Greece.
programme.sub-title: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.
programme.sub-title: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.
programme.sub-title: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2009: The End of Time Part 1: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2009: The End of Time Part 1
programme.desc: Det er julaften, og Doktoren gjenforenes med Wilfred før han møter en gammel fiende.
programme.sub-title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2009: The End of Time Part 1

programme.desc: Amy og Rory er fanget på en romferge på kollisjonskurs i denne julespesialen.

programme.desc: Doktoren og hans nye følgesvenn, Clara, møter den ondsinnede doktor Simeon og en hær av snømenn.

programme.desc: Mens den nylig regenererte Doktoren ligger i koma, er sycorax på vei.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2006: The Runaway Bride: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2006: The Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Doktoren får en ny følgesvenn, og de avdekker en eldgammel utenomjordisk plan.

programme.desc: RMS Titanic rammes av en katastrofe, og Doktoren avdekker en trussel mot hele menneskeheten.

programme.title: The Eyes of My Mother
programme.desc: En avsidesliggende gård er hjemmet til en tidligere kirurg, og der lærer hun datteren Francesca at anatomi er spennende, og døden en selvfølge. Regissør Nicholas Pesce har laget en svart-hvit filmopplevelse som fortsetter der Hitchcock slapp i "Psycho".

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Bernie Kopell
programme.desc: Bernie Kopell ("Doc" on The Love Boat) goes back to the hotel in Niagra Falls, NY where he came eye to eye with a bloody ghost.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A longtime fixture of the paranormal investigative landscape, Mackey’s has developed a reputation for being one of America’s creepiest haunts, supposedly hosting a dark energy that can leave some investigators mentally scarred.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The oldest, and longest running movie theatre in Kentucky is now owned and operated by someone who never once thought about ghosts. However, a shocking experience with a woman dressed in white altered his belief in the supernatural forever.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Augusta is home to Kentucky’s oldest jail, which housed prisoners since the early 1800s and still sits upon its original foundation today. While it now operates as a museum, there have been numerous guests who have claimed to see unexplainable things.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Located on the Perryville Battlefield, the site of one of the Civil War’s bloodiest fights, the HP Bottom House has purportedly witnessed countless apparitions and other chilling phenomena.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tiffany, Tony Plana, Morgan Brittany
programme.desc: An angry teenage Tiffany reads the Satanic bible and unleashes evil from the other side. Tony Plana encounters a cannibalistic entity that leaves him fearing for his life.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tito Ortiz, Cary Elwes. Sally Kellerman, Drake Bell
programme.desc: One of the toughest men in the world, Tito Ortiz, encounters a spirits that terrifies him and his girlfriend. Cary Elwes has a brush with a bone chilling skeletal ghost.
programme.sub-title: Tito Ortiz, Cary Elwes. Sally Kellerman, Drake Bell

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Aaron Carter, Chris McDonald, Kaya Jones, David Proval
programme.desc: Aaron Carter's dying grandmother makes him promise her that he will perform a ritual after she dies to prove that spirits really do exist.
programme.sub-title: Aaron Carter, Chris McDonald, Kaya Jones, David Proval

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Rowdy Roddy Piper, Skylar Grey, Frank Whaley
programme.desc: After Rowdy's best friend Adrian Adonis dies tragically, Rowdy learns that Adrian has his back even from the beyond. Skylar Grey, at a low point in her career, is viciously attacked by an evil spirit in her hotel room.
programme.sub-title: Rowdy Roddy Piper, Skylar Grey, Frank Whaley

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Block
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The historic home of JP Speed has morphed into an Arts College, carrying on the legacy of the local entrepreneur’s second wife, Harriet, who was passionate about sharing her love for music and the humanities and is said to still be haunting the home.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Guests and employees of Hall Place have witnessed furniture moving on its own and apparitions of Civil War Union Soldiers ambling through the halls. The tunnels beneath were reportedly used for the underground railroad.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with a paranormal investigator who meticulously kept records on the town jail and has kept in contact with a variety of folks who worked there, including one of the location’s original jailers.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Situated near Kentucky's famous Mammoth Caves, the Grand Victorian Inn has carried the hopes of several businesses, residents, educators, and children since it was first erected in 1885. Now, its current owners have experienced a litany of ghostly claims.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Linda Dano
programme.desc: Psychic Medium Kim Russo visits the home of Actress Linda Dano (Another World, One Life To Live) and finally discovers who has been haunting her 18th century house for the past two decades.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 6

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 1
programme.desc: Dannii Minogue joins host Elle Macpherson and Tyson Beckford as 28 hopefuls begin their battle for a modelling contract with a leading agency. The girls pull out all the stops but only half of them will survive the cull.

programme.desc: It's time for the contestants to receive their makeovers and host Elle Macpherson embraces the challenge by opting for a new look herself. After their transformations, the girls pose like professional gymnasts with Olympian Louis Smith.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4
programme.desc: Chemistry with the camera is imperative for a top model, so to separate the sizzlers from the fizzlers, the girls must pose with male models.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson shares her top tips in a modelling workshop before Tyson challenges the girls to shine on a shoot in an ex-coal mine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 6
programme.desc: The final ten sample the flamboyant world of high fashion in a catwalk show with unusual accessories, before bearing all for a nude shoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7
programme.desc: The contestants demonstrate their acting skills in milk commercials before taking part in a photoshoot inspired by classic children's stories.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Caress oppdager Emily og Bens hemmelighet, og Blake blir forrådt av en gammel venn. Alexis pønsker ut en plan for å vende den kinesiske regjeringen mot Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake blir lurt til å låne penger fra Alexis. Jackie kommer hjem med sjokkerende nyheter. Blake finner ut hvem kvinnen som kan redde omdømmet hans er.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: En skyldbetynget Alexis frykter at hun er for sent ute når hun finner Amanda bevisstløs. Dominique frir til Garrett. Steven tror han kan miste Danny til Sammy Jo og Clay.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Ben beviser at Blake og Alexis er uhederlige og får kontroll over leiekontraktene i Sør-Kina-havet. Steven prøver å avdekke Adams hemmelighet. Dominiques bryllup nærmer seg.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake angriper Alexis når hun prøver å overta herskapshuset. En forstyrret Claudia fanges av en vegg av flammer. Sammy Jo og Amanda kjemper om Clays gunst.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle berger livet til Alexis ved å roe ned en rasende Blake. Mens La Mirage brenner, blir Amanda reddet av en mystisk fremmed. Claudia omkommer i brannen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: En rasende Blake ser avisoverskriftene som anklager ham for mordbrann. Adam sverger på å være lojal mot Alexis og Colbyco.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Når Krystle kommer seg etter ulykken, overtaler Alexis statsadvokaten til å mistenke Blake for mordbrann. Dominique tilbyr Blake et lån på 50 millioner dollar.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake sparker sjefen på La Mirage for å ha holdt tilbake viktig informasjon om brannen. Alexis tilbyr en belønning for å få arrestert og dømt brannstifteren.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystles svimmelhet får henne til å oppsøke legen. Jackie husker at hun så at La Mirage-brannen startet på Claudias rom, og beviser at Blake er uskyldig.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blakes reise til Caracas for å befri Caress mislykkes. Dex frir til Alexis og blir avvist. Dex går med på å hjelpe Blake med å få Caress ut av fengsel.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake og Dex greier å befri Caress fra fengselet, og hun vender tilbake til Denver med en sterk hevnlyst.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Caress sverger på å ta hevn for årene i fengsel. Michael Culhane bruker Zach Powers for å kjøpe opp tretti prosent av «The Crater»-prosjektet. Sammy Jo forteller en fortvilet Clay at hun er gravid.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Caress fortsetter å utpresse Emily Fallmont. Clay, som lider av skyldfølelse, frir til Sammy Jo, i ekte Las Vegas-stil. Michael blir tvunget til å fortelle Amanda sannheten.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: En døende Emily bønnfaller Blake om å bruke brevet hun skrev for å få slutt på Alexis og Bens forræderi. Clay og Sammy Jo gifter seg. Nick Kimball prøver utrettelig å vinne Dominiques gunst.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake bruker Emilys brev for å finne en måte å gjenvinne imperiet på. Sammy Jo finner ut at hun ikke er gravid, men holder det hemmelig for Clay.

programme.desc: A 4400 launches a terrorist attack against NTAC that causes the males to revert to their primal instincts.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Carved beneath Dover's White Cliffs, tunnels dating to medieval times served as WWII command centres where Operation Dynamo was planned. The Fan Bay Deep Shelter housed 200 soldiers. Today, these historic passages are open to explore.

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned 1910 Spanish Revival mansion with dark secrets, marble staircases, hidden rooms, and rumored ties to JFK and mysterious societies.
programme.sub-title: JFK’s Abandoned Multi-Million Mansion Found Hidden Secret Room

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Hidden in County Wicklow's woods, this eerie Irish sculpture park features massive black granite statues exploring birth, death, and the darker sides of the human mind. Designed for adult reflection, every figure tells a deeply thought-provoking story.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring one of the world’s most amazing abandoned theme parks in China, built to rival Disney but abandoned after going bankrupt just a few years later.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Japan's Fukushima radiation zone, urban explorers document abandoned JDM cars left since the 2011 nuclear disaster. Geiger counter in hand, they discover rare models including an R32 GTR and an Evo VII frozen in time.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned 5-star casino hotel in Macau, once closed by the government over safety issues and rumored crime, now left as a haunting time capsule.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Cranebank near Heathrow trained thousands of British Airways staff from the 1960s until 2021, now abandoned as a haunting aviation relic.
programme.sub-title: The Abandoned London Airport Terminal: 747 Planes Parked Forever (Shocking Discovery)

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: A cancelled China road trip leads to exploring an abandoned luxury villa park with pools, saunas, a cinema, and lavish interiors slowly reclaimed by nature.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Inside an abandoned Fukushima house and store, explorers uncover rare Japanese gaming memorabilia and toys untouched since the 2011 nuclear disaster. Rising radiation levels and structural hazards add danger to every step.

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Steve explores Taiwan’s abandoned UFO Village, a bizarre ghost town filled with futuristic homes that look straight out of another world.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Silver City Galleria was a large Taunton, MA mall with 120 stores and many amenities. It served the region and was demolished in 2021.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: A billionaire heir inherited a 15,000 sq ft mansion and luxury cars. After losing his wife, he hoarded until his death, leaving it frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Almost Robbed In Abandoned Mansion (Millions of Dollars and Cars Left Behind)

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Explorers visit a uniquely surreal abandoned house whose entire front façade has collapsed, exposing the interior like a doll's house. The adventure takes an unexpected turn when local farmers arrive and start firing a shotgun in the garden.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned top secret Titan I missile silo in Colorado, one of six built during the Cold War when nuclear missiles stood ready for launch.
programme.sub-title: Secret Titan I Missile Silo of the United States

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Scotland, Dan venture through a vast, decaying Victorian psychiatric hospital. Untouched patient rooms and medical equipment lie abandoned. The team uncovers dark histories of overcrowding and mistreatment, while hunting for paranormal activity.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned car factory in Sicily where Fiat Panda, Punto, 500 and Lancia Ypsilon were built, closed in 2011 and now planned for reindustrialization.
programme.sub-title: Exploring a Complete Intact Abandoned Car Factory

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned property once sold to become a horse preserve, left undeveloped for years, with stories of its former owners adding mystery.
programme.sub-title: This Abandoned Mansion Still Had Jewelry Locked Inside

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Dan enters a long-abandoned hospital deep in Japan's Fukushima Red Zone. Overgrown paths and radiation fears set an uneasy tone as the team investigates the eerie site, encountering unexplained noises along the way.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Formosa Fun Coast in Taiwan closed after a 2015 color powder fire killed 15 and injured 508. The park has been abandoned ever since.
programme.sub-title: The Accident That Shocked the World - Abandoned Water Park Disaster

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned luxury hotel near Dubai, once built as a palace for Abu Dhabi rulers, closed since 2016 and now frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Discovered an Abandoned Luxury Hotel in Dubai

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Greeks Play Land, built in 1970 by The Greek for handicapped children using repurposed materials, was free to all but closed after his death due to lack of upkeep.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring abandoned military sites in France and Kuwait, from a NATO airbase with Soviet gear to Saddam Husseins vehicle graveyard on Failaka Island.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Armies: Soviet Tanks & Saddam’s Rusting War Machines

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring Colorado’s abandoned mining sites and the forbidden ghost town of Gilman, closed in 1984 by the EPA due to toxic pollution.

programme.title: Phenomena NO
programme.desc: Åtte måneder etter at en ukjent morder kappet hodet av en turist, ankommer den unge Jennifer Corvino til Sveits for å begynne på sin nye privatskole. Når Jennifer går i søvne blir hun vitne til et nytt drap og går seg vill i skogen.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Raven
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Belize police superintendent is found dead in the water, shot with his own gun. The only witness? A Canadian socialite with ties to one of the country's most powerful families. Her story didn't add up.
programme.sub-title: MURDER OR ACCIDENT? The Devastating Case of Henry Jemmott and Jasmine Hartin

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1991, 19-year-old aspiring actress Heather Stigliano was beaten and stabbed to death in her Myrtle Beach apartment during a robbery. James Whipple was caught weeks later and confessed, saying he killed her for drug money.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1994, 6-year-old Rikki Neave was strangled by 13-year-old James Watson in Peterborough, England. His mother was wrongly accused. DNA evidence eventually solved the case in 2022, nearly 30 years later.
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Almost Got Away

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton

programme.desc: While hosting her first Trill initiate, Dax discovers a tiny, developing universe, which threatens to destroy the station as it expands.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Blood Oath
programme.desc: Dax risks her life and her future with Starfleet to fulfill a blood oath made with three aged Klingons.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Crossover
programme.desc: A mishap in the wormhole sends Kira and Bashir into an alternate universe where Bajor is a tyrannical power and humans are slaves.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Quarks hus
programme.desc: In order to boost his business and gain respect, Quark lies about killing a Klingon, then winds up forced to marry the dead man's widow.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Picard, Troi, and Geordi are held prisoner by Data, who has left the Enterprise to join his evil brother Lore as leaders of the Borg.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Data's first bad dream turns into a real-life nightmare for the rest of the Enterprise crew.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The new Starship Enterprise and its crew set out “to boldly go where no one has gone before." Their first mission is to explore the mystery surrounding the creation of the Farpoint station located on planet Deneb IV.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: At the trial, "Q" continues to denounce humans, while Picard defends his race and convinces "Q" that the upcoming mission at Farpoint will be the perfect opportunity to prove his point.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After diverting to a secret meeting with an old friend and some of Starfleet's finest commanders, Picard finds the Horatio blown to bits just hours after the meeting and he returns the Enterprise to Earth looking for answers.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: With Picard away for routine surgery, the Enterprise responds to an apparent distress call from a Pakled vessel.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Responding to a distress call on one of the Federation's outer-most colonies, the Enterprise arrives...only to find a big hole in the ground where the town used to be, and discovers the Borg are behind the attack.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Commander Riker had no choice as acting captain but fire full force on the Borg starship, despite Picard being on board of it, altered to a Borg calling himself Locutus, both ships are damaged.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Scorpion, Part 2
programme.desc: The Voyager crew finds a solution to combat the invader of Borg space.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Gift
programme.desc: The crew must say goodbye to one member of their family just as they are adjusting to a new one.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Raven
programme.desc: Haunting visions lead Seven of Nine on a quest to rejoin the Collective.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: One
programme.desc: With the fate of the crew in her hands, Seven must face her deepest fears alone.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Drone
programme.desc: The pupil becomes the teacher when a Borg drone is born on Voyager and Seven of Nine instructs him in the ways of humanity.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Infinite Regress
programme.desc: Seven experiences the Borg version of multiple personality disorder.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Relativity
programme.desc: Voyager’s future depends on Seven’s success in preventing the past.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Tsunkatse
programme.desc: Killing for sport becomes Seven’s only means of survival when she is abducted into a ring of fisticuffs.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Child's Play
programme.desc: The Voyager crew must rescue a young boy being used as a weapon of destruction against the Borg

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Unimatrix Zero, Part 1
programme.desc: Captain Janeway faces her biggest battle yet against the Borg—assimilation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Duett
programme.desc: Kira discovers that a Cardassian visiting the station could actually be a notorious war criminal.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Det er på tide med videomeldinger og Mark avslører en annen sjokkerende vri. De single får også lov til å sende videomeldinger. Hvem mottar en melding?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene drar på romantiske overnattingsdater med de beste single. Ny romantikk blomstrer, kjærlighetserklæringer og fremtidsplaner lages, og mer enn én person lar seg friste.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene Marisela & Christopher og Vanessa & Roberto gjenforenes for deres eksplosive siste bål. Var forholdet deres sterkt nok til å seire på Temptation Island?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Kaitlin & Hall og Paris & Great gjenforenes til sine siste bålseremonier. Bål har en egen evne til å avdekke sannheten – selv om denne sannheten har vært en løgn.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene og de single vender tilbake til en dramatisk gjenforening på 90 minutter etter tiden på øya.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En time med tidligere usett materiale, inkludert dramatiske øyeblikk fra bålseremoniene, avsløringer fra deltakerne og mye mer.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: ire nye par tar en reise til Temptation Island for å se om forholdet deres tåler alt.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlene flytter inn, og det går vilt for seg. Det første «bålet» byr på smertefulle oppvåkninger.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Noen par begynner å nyte sin nyvunnede uavhengighet, mens andre forblir fast i fortiden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Spenningen øker i villaene, og linjene blir uklare på Anything But Clothes-festen.

programme.desc: Med femtio partier ombord är Dylan värd för undertecknandet av stadgan för det nya samväldet, men upptäcker snart att det finns inkräktare som är fast beslutna att stoppa undertecknandet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Om hjulet är fast
programme.desc: Beka och Tyr tas över av energin från en dimensionell tunnel. Dylan, Trance och Harper måste rädda dem innan de förstör skeppet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skärvor
programme.desc: Dylan blir anklagad för mord och måste rentvå sitt namn samtidigt som han hittar delarna till en vas som sägs ge ägaren "kosmos välsignelser".

programme.title: Andromeda: Galet att bli räddad
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en grupp flyktingar, men upptäcker att de har utsatts för regeringsexperiment och är extremt instabila.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekkas farbror kandiderar till ett ämbete i det nya samväldet, men ett mordförsök får besättningen att agera som hans säkerhetsvakt.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensamma och jämna sanden
programme.desc: När Andromeda attackeras av rymdpirater räddas de av ett sedan länge försvunnet rymdskepp från jorden.
