programme.title: On the Case: Nine Days of Terror
programme.desc: When a young college student disappears out of a mall parking lot, police find themselves in a race against time to find her before it is too late.

programme.title: On the Case: Veil of Suspicion
programme.desc: A beloved husband and father is found executed in front of his home.

programme.title: On the Case: A Hole in their Hearts
programme.desc: A mother of three disappears from her office in broad daylight, and the case remains open for eight years until two farmers unearth a clue.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder in Room 205
programme.desc: A young woman's journey to a new life comes to a savage end in a roadside motel.

programme.title: On the Case: Half Way Home
programme.desc: The discovery of a woman's body inside an abandoned trailer leads to a 28-year search for the person responsible for her beating death.

programme.title: On the Case: 22 Hours of Terror
programme.desc: A 12-year-old girl is kidnapped during a home invasion, and police frantically search for her and her abductor. Paula Zahn explores the case.

programme.title: On the Case: From Dusk to Darkness
programme.desc: After a 10-year-old girl mysteriously disappears, her family and the police undergo a tormenting journey to find a lead.

programme.title: On the Case: A Stranger Among Us
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Velda Rumfelt's disappearance in Brentwood, Missouri, in 1977 marked the beginning of a tragic, decades long mystery.

programme.title: On the Case: This is for Her
programme.desc: A deadly home invasion leaves a father of three dead. Why was the victim's wife, the only eyewitness to the crime left alive?

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Shelley Sikes vanishes one night after her shift, and then her abandoned, blood-streaked car is discovered on a dark roadway.

programme.title: On the Case: The Long Path to Justice
programme.desc: A couple's daily walk ends in murder and a cloud of suspicion descends on the victim's family.

programme.title: On the Case: A Father's Quest
programme.desc: After finding his beautiful 19 year old daughter dead, a father launches a relentless pursuit of her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Cry on My Shoulder
programme.desc: When a young woman disappears, police zero in on her violent ex-boyfriend. But the secret to solving the case is buried in a cold case file.

programme.title: On the Case: Broken Trust
programme.desc: When a young girl vanishes on the way home from school, her family and police are sent on a tormenting search for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: Stolen Dreams
programme.desc: John Greathouse finds his stepdaughter, Kelli Bailey, murdered in her bedroom; investigators find a video tape and a dead man's forged check and hope these clues will be the keys to bringing Bailey's cold-blooded killer to justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Twice Is No Accident
programme.desc: When Fran Smith mysteriously disappears her sister and daughter mount their own investigation... What they uncover sends police on a cross country man hunt for a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Hidden by Fire
programme.desc: When firefighters respond to a raging house fire they discover the blaze was just the cover up for a vicious murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Mixed Signals
programme.desc: Cell phone records may help solve the disturbing murder of a popular teenager.

programme.title: On the Case: Racing to Justice
programme.desc: A talented chef's abduction is the impetus for what will turn out to be a chilling homicide investigation.

programme.title: On the Case: Evil Repeats Itself
programme.desc: Beautiful teenager Mary Jayne Jones is found murdered in a desolate farmhouse while its owner is out of town.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Ball O'Snags
programme.desc: An engine fire and series of mechanical gremlins has Buffalo scrambling to make its Christmas deliveries. Newest rampie Prefkar Mony struggles with life in the North.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shootout
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot David faces a remote Arctic airstrip with sketchy landing gear. Mikey drafts a Buffalo hockey team to face off against an NHL squad in a charity shootout. Chuck gets a chance to shine on the ice.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Last Days
programme.desc: Sparks fly when Joe discovers Gord has taken a job with a rival airline after completing expensive training on one of the Buffalo planes

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Push Comes to Shove
programme.desc: Trying to make his mark at Buffalo, Duane lands two more Electra contracts. But his over- zealous efforts result in a clash with the crew and with Joe, and a down-to-the-wire midnight departure to meet a deadline.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Solid
programme.desc: AJ and James battle a DC-4 engine fire. It's Joe's 69th birthday - and he's never flown a helicopter before, so Mikey plans a special gift of chopper flight lessons.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Fire and Ice
programme.desc: When a deadly fire destroys a northern outpost a week before Christmas, Buffalo puts everything aside to come to the rescue. Cargo Manager Kelly receives a shocking diagnosis that renews her fight to quit smoking.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Don't Muck with Chuck
programme.desc: Crusty mechanic Chuck leads the scramble to ready the Electra for a disaster relief mission in Haiti, but fate's curveball sends them to the High Arctic instead.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Meltdown
programme.desc: As spring arrives and Ray's retirement day approaches, Sean surprises everyone by leaving Buffalo for a job with the competition. So Buffalo brings in Electra pilot Brian Harrison to finish the contract.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Finish Line
programme.desc: A multi-stop mission to the Far North has Devan, Scott and Adam facing a series of white- knuckle obstacles.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: 40/40/40
programme.desc: Mechanic Cory races against the clock to turn two short-haul waterbombers into transatlantic aircraft for the epic journey to Turkey. It's up to engineer Adam to get the C-46 crew out of a jam on a remote airstrip in minus 40.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Duane lands a huge contract for the Electra and puts enormous pressure on mechanic Adam to prep the plane without the help of his mentor Chuck.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Chief Pilot Arnie lands the DC-3 on a homemade sand strip at a remote lodge. Electra expert Chuck goes one-on-one with a stubborn power unit, and Rod's wife Sasha goes into labour with the newest member of the McBryan family.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Rock Stars and Rampies
programme.desc: Facing Joe's wrath, Rod and Cory head to the UK to make urgent water bomber repairs. David tries to prove himself to Devan in the C-46 but ends up infuriating Devan. Will makes an ultimatum in Hay River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shut Down
programme.desc: Joe receives a negative visit from Transport Canada when inspectors threaten to shut down the airline. Ray and the Electra crew fly to Sachs Harbour to pick up a unique load - the hides, wool, and meat of 250 musk oxen.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Buffalo Scores
programme.desc: Buffalo scores the charter of a lifetime when they're asked to transport the Stanley Cup on a tour of the North. Cup fever spreads quickly around Buffalo, and for Mikey, what begins as an innocent love for this hockey icon soon becomes an obsession.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: On the Move
programme.desc: A charter flight falls through the cracks after the McBryans attend a wild family wedding, and an irate Joe pulls captain Justin from the Turkey test flights to do the job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: D-Day
programme.desc: Mikey's much-planned D-Day tribute parachute jump with 20 paratroopers hits a wall when Joe refuses to fly his DC-3 to the drop zone.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Change of Seasons
programme.desc: When her husband quits after a blowout with Joe, Kelly is put in a terrible position. Will she stay at Buffalo - or will she go? Scott gets the news he must stand down from flying so another co-pilot can fast-track to captain.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Auction Hunters, Ink.
programme.desc: Autographed 1960s Bob Shaw Swing Gate tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition 22hp chainsaw; six foot chainsaw-carved cedar bear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
programme.desc: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington

programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!

programme.desc: In October of 2009, 20-year-old Noor Almaleki and Amal Khalaf, the mother of her boyfriend Marwan, walked out of a Peoria, Arizona DES office and were struck by an SUV driven by Noor's father and Iraqi immigrant, Faleh Hassan Almaleki.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Shelley's Last Breath
programme.desc: An investigation into the 1999 scuba diving death of Shelley Tyre while on vacation on the Caribbean isle of Tortola. Police questioned her husband and dive partner David Swain about every detail of the dive; autopsy results were inconclusive.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Soccer Moms Confidential
programme.desc: A report on the investigation of ex-cop turned private eye Chris Butler who staffed his San Francisco Bay area firm with local soccer moms to solve cases.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Mystery on Twin Peaks Drive
programme.desc: A report on the December 16, 1998 death of Ronda Reynolds, whose husband found her lifeless body with a gunshot wound to the head in her home on Twin Peaks Drive in Toledo, Washington.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Stranger Beside Me
programme.desc: In 2010, Jamie Laiaddee vanished from her home in a suburb of Phoenix. Her boyfriend Bryan Stewart told everyone she had moved to Colorado to take a new job. When detectives started searching for Jamie, they discovered Bryan was a con man.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Ransom
programme.desc: A report on the mysterious 2008 disappearance of Robert Wiles, the son of millionaire business owner Tom Wiles, who received an e-mail ransom note demanding $750,000 for the safe return of the 26-year-old.

programme.title: 48 Hours: An Officer and a Hero
programme.desc: On how a firefighter, with the help of his girlfriend, an unarmed police officer, survived a brutal home invasion.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Live to Tell: Three Days Before Christmas
programme.desc: The story of sisters Linae and Tricia Tiede who in December 1990, were held hostage by two men -- Von Lester Taylor and Edward Steven Deli.
programme.sub-title: Live to Tell: Three Days Before Christmas

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in the OC
programme.desc: A report on the 1994 murder of millionaire businessman Bill McLaughlin in his California home. After his divorce, he became involved with the much younger Nanette Johnston, who it was later discovered, made a habit of seeking out wealthy men to date.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Friends for Life
programme.desc: A report about Robyn Davis and Carol "Sissy" Saltzman, best friends for twenty years, who were charged with murder after Robyn's husband, Brian Davis, was found shot to death alongside his car on an isolated road in St. Charles, Louisiana.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Unraveling the Lies of Jodi Arias
programme.desc: 4 years after the death of Travis Alexander, Arias was found guilty of first-degree murder. At first, she told police she knew nothing of the killing, then at trial, she admitted her involvement in his murder, but claimed it was in self-defense.
programme.sub-title: Unraveling the Lies of Jodi Arias

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: In April 2006, Matt Baker, a pastor from Waco, Texas, returned home to find his wife Kari unconscious, with an empty bottle of Unisom and a suicide note beside her. Police ruled it a suicide. However, her family believed otherwise.

programme.title: Burying The Ex

programme.title: Delirious
programme.desc: Toby støder ind i den fallerede paparazzo, Les, og tilbyder at arbejde som hans ulønnede assistent. Les tager Toby under sine vinger og viser ham alle de beskidte kneb.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
programme.desc: To ensomme sjæle finder kærlighed og en forbindelse midt i storbyens kaos. En hjertevarm fortælling om kunst, skæve eksistenser og humor.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Da den håbløse romantiker Wallace møder Chantry, har de kemi med det samme. Der er bare ét problem: hun har en kæreste. De beslutter sig for at ses som venner, men det bliver sværere og sværere at holde venskabet og de voksende følelser adskilt.

programme.title: Streetdance 3D
programme.desc: Carly og hendes dansecrew er netop kommet i finalen i Storbritaniens største streetdancekonkurrence, da deres leder Jay forlader gruppen. Pludselig står de også uden øvelokale og gruppen er på vej mod opløsning.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: Dette dystre drama følger to bekendte fra high school, Hancock og Danny, efter at de er blevet færdige med deres eksamen. Hancock og hans cheerleader-kæreste vandrer til en middelklasse middelmådighed uden for rækkevidde for Danny og hans psykotiske kone.

programme.title: What Happens In Vegas - Til Jackpot Os Skiller
programme.desc: Jack (Ashton Kutcher) og Joy (Cameron Diaz) vågner op og opdager, at de er blevet gift! I stedet for annullering idømmes de ½ års ægteskab, da Jack vinder 3 mio. med Joys penge. De vil gøre alt for at snyde hinanden, men kærlighed vinder mod alle odds.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: I længere tid end han kan huske har John Clark levet et kedeligt liv. Han har en god karriere, en charmerende kone og en familie, der elsker ham, men der mangler stadig noget.

programme.title: Bare Juliet
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er kørt træt i sit parforhold med Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), der er kæmpefan af musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Da en demoversion af Tuckers gamle hit LP dukker op, bliver det starten på et nyt møde med den flyvske kunstner.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Joel and Molly fall in and out of love in this hilarious spoof on a romantic comedy from the director of WET HOT AMERICAN SUMMER and ROLE MODELS.

programme.title: The Neon Demon
programme.desc: Den purunge kvinde, Jesse (Elle Fanning), flytter til Los Angeles for at forsøge at skabe sig en karriere som fotomodel. Her spottes hun af en af byens førende modelagenter og efter en prøvefotografering bliver hun hurtigt talk of town,

programme.desc: Ejendomsmægleren Tobias og arkitekten Mads får en vanskelig opgave når de skal finde et hus til Lea og Sebastian fra Brønshøj.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 203
programme.desc: Vi besøger Camilla og Frederik på Frederiksberg, som desperat har brug for hjælp da lejligheden parret bor i skal sælges lige om lidt. De har også virkelig brug for mere luft og grønne områder.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 204
programme.desc: Pernille og Søren ønsker brændende at komme tilbage til Horsens, hvor de begge to er vokset op. De har allerede solgt lejligheden så Tobias får meget travlt med at finde et hus til parret.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 205
programme.desc: Det unge par Molly og Morten vil gerne tage skridtet og flytte fra deres meget lille lejlighed i København til Silkeborg, hvor Mortens forældre bor i nærheden af.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 301
programme.desc: Astrid og Steffen skal købe deres første hus, men de kan slet ikke gå på kompromis med deres mange ønsker. De møder programmets eksperter som skal købe et hus på parrets vegne.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 302
programme.desc: Louise og Michael er vokset ud af deres lille lejlighed i Århus og har akut brug for mere plads. Parret går på kompromis, og Louise møder sit store mareridt i det hus som eksperterne køber til dem.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 303
programme.desc: Charlotte og Mikkel bor i så lille en lejlighed, at brusekabinen skal tømmes for ting hver gang de skal bade. Men nu vil de meget gerne flytte lidt ud af byen med deres søn.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 304
programme.desc: Pernille og Nicklas fra Odense bor så småt, at hvis man skal have lidt privatliv, er der kun toilettet at ty til. Nicklas drømmer om få et køkken med mange blus og to ovne, så han kan lave mere mad.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 305
programme.desc: Wendy og Jesper fra Kalundborg bor i forvejen godt i en lejlighed, der har en formidabel udsigt, men en kommende familieforøgelse gør, at de skal finde noget der er større.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 306
programme.desc: Jonas og Louise bliver rystede, da de ser hvilket hus de har råd til. Mads Mikkelsen og Tobias Edlev Nielsen er denne gang kommet på overarbejde for at prøve at imødekomme parrets ønsker.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Mit navn er Nobody
programme.desc: I denne klassiske western er den berygtede og legendariske revolvermand Jack Beauregard (Henry Fonda) på jagt efter sin brors mordere. Han har sat sig for, at denne morderjagt skal blive afslutningen på en lang karriere.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banana Joe er ellers sådan en fredelig fyr, men nu har han ikke noget andet valg end, på ægte 'Bud Spencer' manér, at smide mafiaen ud af landsbyen Amanlido, så der igen kan blive fredeligt at bo der!

programme.title: Gi' den hele armen
programme.desc: Trinity brødrene, som vi har vredet os af grin over som western helte, skal her opleves som luftens cowboys. Luften over Sydamerika er blevet temmelig usikker. De to helte skal sørge for at få gamle højt forsikrede flyvemaskiner til at styrte ned.

programme.title: Fantomet
programme.desc: Historien begynder da en ekspedition ankommer til øen Bengalla på jagt efter Tugandas legendariske kranier. Disse kranier menes at besidde en energi med enorme kræfter, der kan betyde en katastrofe for hele menneskeheden.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: En ejendomsmægler bliver tiltalt for et mord, han ikke har begået, og han beslutter sig for at bevise, at han er uskyldig.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: 'Cold War' er en passioneret kærlighedshistorie om to mennesker med meget forskellig baggrund og vidt forskellige temperamenter. De er helt forkerte for hinanden, men er alligevel via skæbnen dømt til at forblive sammen.

programme.title: Blue Hawaii
programme.desc: Hans mor (Angela Lansbury) forventer, at han avancerer i sin karriere. Men Elvis vil hellere gå med en aloha-skjorte end jakkesæt, så han tager arbejde som rejseleder. Heldige Elvis: hans første kunder er en bil fuld af søde piger.

programme.title: Donovan'S Reef
programme.desc: The Duke, Lee Marvin og Jack Warden spiller marinekamerater som har gjort den fransk-polynesiske øya Haleakaloha til sitt paradis etter krigen. Det lokale hovedkvarteret er Donovan's Reef, Waynes vannhull.

programme.title: Paths Of Glory
programme.desc: Stanley Kubricks stærke film om krigens absurditet, hvor Kirk Douglas spiller en kommanderende officer, der forsvarer tre syndebukke, der står for retten for et mislykket angreb i den franske hær i 1916. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: Fjern, så tæt! er en tysk fantasy-film fra 1993 instrueret af Wim Wenders. Manuset er af Wenders, Richard Reitinger og Ulrich Zieger. Det er en efterfølger til Wenders 'film Wings of Desire fra 1987.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 212
programme.desc: På Hundested havn ligger Auktionen Café og madhus, som ejes af danseren Thomas Evers Poulsen og hans familie.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 409
programme.desc: I Aabenraa ved fjorden, på stranden ligger restaurant Under Sejlet. Det er en af de bedre restauranter eller vil i hvert fald gerne være det, men kunderne udebliver og mens underskuddet vokser stødt.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 208
programme.desc: Dårlig mad, elendig ledelse og amatører i kokkeklæder er bare nogle af de skrækscenarier, der venter i TV3´s anden sæson af dokumentarprogramserien med Kniven for Struben.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 501
programme.desc: På Gesten Kro er forpagteren Tim på 34 år magtesløs. Aften efter aften står restauranten tom, og når der endelig kommer gæster, bliver de ikke længere end højest nødvendigt.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 105
programme.desc: Da ægteparret Michaela og Michael første gang kom forbi det idylliske Pakhusgaarden i Lundeborg på Fyn, forelskede de sig øjeblikkeligt i stedet.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 209
programme.desc: For halvandet år siden overtog Mickey Christiansen "Langeliniebroen", som før var mere bodega end restaurant. I køkkenet har Mickey ansat kokken Karin, der laver smørrebrød som hun altid har gjort.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 309
programme.desc: Mustafa ejer den tyrkiske restaurant Marmaris. Her arbejder hele hans familie, men det er efterhånden også de eneste, der kommer i restauranten. På trods af at Mustafa har brugt en formue på at renovere stedet, er omsætningen gået helt i stå.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 207
programme.desc: I august 2007 åbnede Gry Kibsgaard sin danske café i Flensborg. I den første tid var der gæster nok, men det varede ikke længe, før caféen stod tom og Grys underskud begyndte at vokse.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 211
programme.desc: Midt på Fredericias gågade ligger græske Restaurant Athene, som ejes af Georgios Mitilenios, der selv står i køkkenet. Bo Bech kommer for at hjælpe Georgios

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 204
programme.desc: Dean har mere end 25 års erfaring fra det københavnske restaurationsmiljø, så alt tegnede lovende, da han for tre år siden åbnede Chantilly i hjertet af København.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 412
programme.desc: Lige uden for Køge ligger Søvilla Kro og Motel. For vennerne Johnny og Michael var det en drøm der gik i opfyldelse, da de for lidt over et år siden købte kroen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 101
programme.desc: Restaurant La Sosta er en ægte italiensk restaurant i hjertet af Frederiksberg. Den italienske ejer Giovanni og hans søn Sandro tager selv imod i døren. Og accenten fornægter sig ikke.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 401
programme.desc: Bo Bech går om bord på Bornholmerfærgen, som er en af verdens største katamaraner med plads til 1400 mennesker.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 201
programme.desc: Ægteparret Claus og Kristina knokler 100 timer om ugen for at få Den lille havfrue til at løbe rundt. Men de har trods det ikke råd til at give sig selv løn, og nu er motivationen så småt ved at forsvinde.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 301
programme.desc: I efteråret 2010 overtog slagteren Stig Restaurant Bennick’s i Kolding. Stig elsker kød og har kun amerikanske bøffer på kortet. Men det er kunderne ligeglade med, for de bliver væk, og Stig har endnu ikke fået løn.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 505
programme.desc: På Restaurant Strandlyst i turistbyen Vig skal der tjenes mange penge om sommeren, hvis restauranten skal køre rundt. Restauranten kæmper med ikke at klare det store sommer-ryk ind i højsæsonen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 701
programme.desc: Carsten driver restaurant Karin’s Hjemmelavede i Næstved. Men jobbet som restauratør, er dog noget uvant for den tidligere VVS’er, der ingen erfaring har på området.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 408
programme.desc: Vanløse, tæt på København ligger Restaurant Bella, en indisk restaurant. Eller -det er hvad Bo Bech tror, det er. Men da han ankommer viser det sig også at være en grillbar, kiosk og bar, som serverer kinesisk mad.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 405
programme.desc: I Grenå, tæt på havnen, ligger Restaurant Dagens ret, det har den gjort i halvandet år, men det er svært for ejeren Claus Lyster Nielsen, at få det til at hænge sammen.

programme.title: COPS: Checked Luggage
programme.desc: Agents of the US Customs and Border Protection pursue a vehicle. Border agents spot two undocumented people. Airport Customs detains a man when agents suspect he might be carrying more than luggage.

programme.title: COPS: Uncomfortable Shoes
programme.desc: A driver takes police on a neighborhood chase. Officers are called to capture a 12-foot python hiding outside a home. Officers suspect a motorist with a funny walk is hiding something up his shoe.

programme.title: COPS: In-Law Problems
programme.desc: US Marshals are tasked with finding a young boy that has been kidnapped for ransom. A man suspected of dealing contraband is turned in by his ex-girlfriends mother.

programme.title: COPS: Set Some Boundaries
programme.desc: A couple gets into a fight with their in-laws when they attempt to take their baby on a 3am drive. A man is attacked by his roommate after he gets 'too friendly' with a woman in the home.

programme.title: COPS: Invisible Intruders
programme.desc: A homeowner shoots at intruders only he can see. The driver of a stolen truck claims he's just trying to return the vehicle.. A argument about parenting styles turns ugly when a gun is pulled.

programme.title: COPS: Dance Fighting
programme.desc: A dispute inside a nightclub turns into a street fight. A man patrols his neighborhood 'Old West' style. A K-9 unit is called in to track a burglar on the run.

programme.title: COPS: Do Not Disturb
programme.desc: A prostitute tries to outrun the police during a foot chase. A man claims he can only meet women at motels since he lives with his mom.

programme.title: COPS: Tree Hugging
programme.desc: An ex-felon threatens to kill his spouse after she announces she want to divorce him. A driver has suspicious plants in her car. A woman crashes her friends truck into a pedestrian and a tree.

programme.title: COPS: Crawling to Vegas
programme.desc: A driver leads police on a slow speed chase towards Las Vegas. Three people are suspected of using contraband. A multi-neighbor dispute devolves into a fight involving guns and bats.

programme.title: COPS: First Do No Harm
programme.desc: A suicidal man tries to taunt police into shooting him. Undercover officers bust up an illegal operation at a pain management clinic. A woman claims she's just a bystander to a motorcycle hit and run.

programme.title: COPS: Safe Cracking
programme.desc: A man stages a sit-in in his car in an attempt to stop it from being towed. A homeowner denies that he's selling drugs despite the large amount of evidence found in his home.

programme.title: COPS: High Jump Fail
programme.desc: A family with kids is taken on a high speed car chase. An intoxicated suspect tries to jump a fence while protesting that he's not trying to run away.

programme.title: COPS: Bumming a Smoke
programme.desc: A runaway motorcycle tries to elude officers by driving on a rough road. An argument over a cigarette turns ugly. Kids throw rocks from an overpass at the wrong car.

programme.title: COPS: Neighborhood Rage
programme.desc: A suspect ditches his bike when stopped and tries to outrun the police. Neighbors fight out a road rage incident with rocks and a baseball bat.

programme.title: COPS: My Bills Won't Wait
programme.desc: A suspect calls the police and states that he wants to kill himself and any officer who tries to help him. None of the three occupants of a stopped car will admit to ownership of a bag of drugs.

programme.title: COPS: Family Therapy
programme.desc: Officers are flagged down and alerted to a group of armed men assaulting people at a nearby home. A fight between a father and his adult son takes a dark turn.

programme.title: COPS: Spiked but Still Moving
programme.desc: A suspect refuses to stop his vehicle even after the officers spike his tires. A dispute over money results in a pregnant woman being attacked.

programme.title: COPS: Nightvision
programme.desc: A man on a late-night bike ride is stopped by officers for not having a headlamp. A suspect in a domestic dispute admits to hitting a woman.

programme.title: COPS: Now It's Lawn Furniture
programme.desc: A traffic stop over a broken brake light turns into a foot chase. A man handles bad news by throwing his furniture out of the window. A vehicle pursuit ends with a K-9 unit's help.

programme.title: COPS: Don't Make her Angry
programme.desc: A man needs police assistance when his angry ex-girlfriend crawls through his window. Police must play hide-and-seek when they attempt to execute an arrest warrant.

programme.title: COPS: And Through the Woods
programme.desc: Officers chase a fleeing suspect as he runs through the woods and into a rose bush. An elderly man puts himself in the middle of a knife fight.

programme.title: COPS: Fight and Flight
programme.desc: Police respond to a fight in progress call, officers tail a vehicle leaving a house known for drug activity, and a man calls the police after his wife pushes his Harley over.

programme.title: COPS: Who Let the Dogs Out?
programme.desc: Police find a burglary suspect up a tree in a California backyard, a parolee at large attempts to flee officers, and a man with a suspended license blows his second chance.

programme.title: COPS: Dead Man Flushing
programme.desc: Officers respond to a fight in progress involving mace at a minimart, and a woman tells police that her boyfriend threatened to flush her late husband's ashes down the drain.

programme.title: COPS: Pistol Packin' Families
programme.desc: A man riding a bike at night with no lights decides to take off rather than talk with police, and a dangerous domestic dispute unfolds on the streets of Texas.

programme.title: COPS: Grown Men Gone Wild
programme.desc: An officer pulls over a man making hand gestures at him while driving, an ex-Marine explains his side of a fight, and a traffic stop reveals a truck full of dogs and drugs.

programme.title: COPS: Kill 'Em With Kindness
programme.desc: Officers respond to a call that a man shot up his parents' house, a fleeing suspect hopes a change of clothes will fool the police, and a shaky hit-and-run story unravels.

programme.title: COPS: The Fighting Kind
programme.desc: A man's addiction forces his family to call the police for help, a driver abandons his car and tries to evade officers on foot, and a man tries to conceal his illegal stash.

programme.title: COPS: Cell Phone Secrets
programme.desc: An uncooperative driver leads police on a high-speed chase, and an alleged convenience store robber in custody won't settle down until he gets a kiss from his girlfriend.

programme.title: COPS: Guns, Hash, and Fire Hydrants
programme.desc: A patrol car en route to a call spooks a driver who then takes off at high speed, leading the officers to pursue him instead, and police investigate shots fired on a home.

programme.title: COPS: Get Off My Roof
programme.desc: Officers deploy a police dog to persuade a reluctant suspect to come down off a roof, and an outdoor birthday celebration is crashed by an alleged drunk driver.

programme.title: COPS: This Man Stabbed Me
programme.desc: Police deploy spike strips to curb a stolen vehicle, a parolee at large speeds away with a two-month-old in the car, and officers try to determine the details of a stabbing.

programme.title: COPS: Blood and Scars, Bro!
programme.desc: A patrolman pursues a scooter speeding through a neighborhood, officers try to subdue a raving man, and a woman has issues with her neighbor's dogs.

programme.title: COPS: My Jewelry's Fragile
programme.desc: A cyclist tries to bolt when questioned by police, a deputy uses a cotton swab to procure evidence from a suspect's mouth, and an unmowed lawn triggers a domestic disturbance.

programme.title: COPS: Fast Food Escape
programme.desc: When officers approach, a suspect flees into a fast-food restaurant. A driver takes his granny's wheels for a dangerous spin with cops in pursuit. Sheriffs catch up to a man who fled the scene of a possible domestic battery.

programme.title: COPS: Late Night Snacks
programme.desc: Officers stop a fleeing vehicle, and a man with a warrant learns that a doughnut shop is not the best place to hide from the police.

programme.title: COPS: Cops We Run the Show
programme.desc: A man on the run with a warrant tries to elude police by busting into a residence and hiding under a blanket, and a fleeing cyclist turns apologetic after being caught.

programme.title: COPS: Doggie Paddle
programme.desc: A man resisting arrest sics his dogs on the police, and a recovering addict about to take his first hit in years wanders into the path of police in pursuit of another suspect.

programme.title: Frasier: Sliding Frasier
programme.desc: Frasiers datingskæbne udfolder sig i et par paralleluniverser.

programme.title: Frasier: Hungry Heart
programme.desc: Niles og Daphne beslutter at gå på slankekur. Roz prøver en ny fantastisk parfume, der tiltrækker mænd. Frasier går på en date med Eileen, Kennys kone.

programme.title: Frasier: Hooping Cranes
programme.desc: Efter Niles skyder et umuligt half-court-skud, synes Frasier, at han er umulig at bo sammen med.

programme.title: Frasier: Docu Drama
programme.desc: Roz laver en rumdokumentar med Senator John Glenn. Niles lærer at flyve med drage.

programme.title: Frasier: It Takes Two to Tangle
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles presser Martins rige kæreste til at redde deres konkursramte privatskole.

programme.title: Frasier: Forgotten But Not Gone
programme.desc: Frasier forlader sin vinklub for at være vært på et nyt radiofænomen og bliver vred over at finde ud af, at den forurettede Niles, klubbens arrogante 'korkmaster', har beordret klubbens gamle medlemmer til ikke at deltage i programmet.

programme.title: Frasier: Daphne Returns
programme.desc: Niles og Daphne 'bliver seriøse' omkring deres romance.

programme.title: Frasier: The Wizard of Roz
programme.desc: Daphne forsøger at bevise Niles om sine synske åbenbaringer, og Frasier er egoistiskm da han opdager, at Roz har en affære med hans mentor.

programme.title: Frasier: Semi-Decent Proposal
programme.desc: Frasier løber ind i en gammel high school-ven og finder ud af, at han føler sig tiltrukket til hendes ven Claire.

programme.title: Frasier: A Passing Fancy
programme.desc: Frasier er tutor for Lanas søn mod en date med Claire. Martin tager til en hundefest, og Daphne og Niles har problemer med at sove i den samme seng.

programme.title: Frasier: Cranes Go Caribbean
programme.desc: Frasiers ferieplaner med Claire viser sig at være katastrofale, da Daphne, Niles og Martin dukker op p ådet samme resort, og Frasier begynder at drømme om Lana.

programme.title: Frasier: A Day in May
programme.desc: Niles bliver jaloux på en af Daphnes gamle flammer i hunddparken; Frasier lærer Lana om ærliged i forbindelse med salg af et stykke problematisk jord, og Martin deltager i al hemmelighed i høringen om prøveløsladelsen af den mand, der skød ham.

programme.title: Frasier: Don Juan in Hell - (Part 1)
programme.desc: Frasier har problemer med at vælge mellem to kvinder og ender med at miste dem begge. Niles tager ved en fejl til en lokal strand nøgen.

programme.title: Frasier: Don Juan in Hell - (Part 2)
programme.desc: Frasier er plaget af sine nylige sorger fra forliste forhold og tager på landet for at få fred og ro, men ender med at at blive konfronteret med forhold fra fortiden og deres spøgelser.

programme.title: Frasier: The First Temptation of Daphne
programme.desc: Daphne plages af jalousi, da hun finder ud af, af en af Niles' patienter er forelsket i ham. Frasier og Martin går langt for at fange en fårekylling, der har gemt sig i lejligheden.

programme.title: Frasier: The Return of Martin Crane
programme.desc: Martins nye job vækker gamle minder.

programme.title: Frasier: Love Stinks
programme.desc: Roz kommer til at stå ansigt til ansigt med sit eget snobberi, da hun dater en skraldemand. Frasiers plan om at overbevise sin kolleger om, at han ikke er en elitær snob, giver bagslag, da han bliver mere populær, end han ønsker.

programme.title: Frasier: Room Full of Heroes
programme.desc: Frasiers psykologiske selskabsleg bringer ubehagelige afsløringer frem til hans Halloweenfest. Niles klæder sig som Martin og drikker sig fuld i øl. Børnene i lejlighedsbygningen tror, at Frasier spiser børnehjerner.

programme.title: Frasier: Bla-Z-Boy
programme.desc: På deres 8. årsdag for deres tid som samboere kommer Frasier ved uheld til at ødelægge Martins lænestol Niles opdager, at Daphne ikke har talent for musik.

programme.title: Frasier: The Two Hundredth
programme.desc: Frasier bliver besat af at finde et bortkommet bånd fra hans programkollektion med i alt 2000 båndede optagelser.

programme.title: Frasier: Sharing Kirby
programme.desc: Blodtrykket og stemningen stiger, da en praktikant bliver gidsel i Frasier og Niles' kamp om en vindkælderrrundvisning.

programme.title: Frasier: Junior Agent
programme.desc: Frasier Crane-programmet får konkurrence. For at vinde konkurrencen og score nogle anmeldelser får Frasier hjælp fra en overraskende side - sin agents assistent.

programme.title: Frasier: Bully for Martin
programme.desc: Martin bliver kritiseret på jobbet og beslutter at droppe det, men Frasier og Niles kan ikke lade det ligge. De beslutter at blande sig, hvilket fører til en langtrukkent indespærring i et lagerrum.

programme.title: Frasier: Mother Lode (Part 1)
programme.desc: Daphnes mors ankomst spolerer hendes planer om at flytte sammen med Niles. Frasier kommer i krig med hans ovenbo om en parkeringsplads.

programme.title: Frasier: Mother Lode (Part 2)
programme.desc: Daphnes mors ankomst spolerer hendes planer om at flytte sammen med Niles. Frasier kommer i krig med sin overbo om en parkeringsplads.

programme.title: Frasier: Juvenilia
programme.desc: Frasier siger ja til at deltage i et program for teenagere for at booste sine anmeldelser blandt yngre lyttere, men bliver udsat for et bagholdsangreb af programmets sensationslystne værter.

programme.title: Frasier: The Proposal
programme.desc: Niles får alle involveret i sine kommende planer om at fri til Daphne. En dårlig timet løgn ødelægger Martins chancer med Peg.

programme.title: Frasier: Wheels of Fortune
programme.desc: Frasier kæmper med ikke at blive indblandet noget med Liliths konspirerende bror.

programme.title: Frasier: Three Blind Dates
programme.desc: Niles, Roz og Martin spiller Kirsten Giftekniv for Frasier.

programme.title: Frasier: War of the Words
programme.desc: Frasier er mere nervøs end sin søn, da Frederick konkurrerer i det nationale stavemesterskab, og far Crane ender med at ødelægge alt for sin søn.

programme.title: Frasier: Deathtrap
programme.desc: Under et genbesøg i deres barndomshjem finder Fraasier og Niles et menneskekranie og bliver besat af at bevise, at deres tidligere udlejer myrdede sin kone.

programme.title: Frasier: The Love You Fake
programme.desc: Da Frasier og hans nabo Cam begynder af skændes, udklækker Martin og Cams mor en plan for at udbedre forholdet.

programme.title: Frasier: Cheerful Goodbyes
programme.desc: Frasier genforenes med sine venner fra 'Cheers'.

programme.title: Frasier: Frasier Has Spokane
programme.desc: Frasier hilser en forkølelse velkommen i sit nye marked i Spokane, da han udskifter en elsket lokal radiopersonlighed.

programme.title: Frasier: The Guilt Trippers
programme.desc: Frasier og Roz er bekymret over deres fortsatte venskab, efter de har sovet sammen. Niles tager til England og leder efter Daphnes far, der er forsvundet.

programme.title: Frasier: Moons over Seattle
programme.desc: Niles får Daphnes far til Seattle i håbet om at overbevise ham om at blive genforenet med hendes mor.

programme.title: Frasier: The Ring Cycle
programme.desc: Niles og Daphne faker to bryllupsceremonier efter at være flygtet til Reno.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Det er det 23. århundrede, og en rumvæsenmagt fordamper havene. For at redde menneskeheden må Kirk og hans besætning rejse tilbage til 1986, hvor de finder en verden fuld af Punk, Pizza og byttebusser, er vildfremmed for dem!

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Besætningen om bord på føderations stjerneskib Enterprise beordres til Nimbus III, den intergalaktiske fredsplanet. De må kun forhandle i en sag om kidnapning for blot at finde ud af, at kidnapperen er i familie med Spock.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Efter flere års krig forbereder føderationen og Klingon-imperiet en fredskonference, da et Klingon-skib næsten bliver ødelagt af et tilsyneladende angreb fra Enterprise. De to verdener ruster sig til deres endelige kamp.

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picards eneste håb for en fremtid hviler hos Nexus...og en legendarisk kaptajn fra fortiden.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Efter en episk kamp mod borgene (cybernetisk forstærkede livsformer), følger kaptajn Picard og hans besætning borgene tilbage til 2000-tallet for at forhindre, at de ændrer jordens tidslinje og den første udenjordiske kontakt.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: Fra føderationens start var hovedreglen klar. Ingen Starfleet-ekspedition må forstyrre den naturlige udvikling af andre civilisationer. Men Picard konfronteres nu med ordrer, der går imod den regel.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Kursen er sat mod en galakse med action og eventyr uden lige, mens kaptajn Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) og hans stjerneskibsbesætning kæmper mod en farlig modstander, som har en overraskende forbindelse til Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: Da et uidentificeret objekt ødelægger de tre mægtige Klingon-krydsere vender kaptajn James T. Kirk (William Shatner) tilbage til det nyligt ombyggede U.S.S. Enterprise(tm) for at overtage kommandoen.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Det er 2200-tallet. Føderationens U.S.S. Enterprise er på en træingsopgave, og admiral James T. Kirk (William Shatner) har forsonet sig med, at inspektionen kan blive den sidste rumrejse i hans karriere. Men Khan er tilbage.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Willy Pomonti Case
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.
programme.sub-title: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: The Last Tango (Saada case)
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Last Tango (Saada case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Strange Farm: The Anaïs Guillaume Affair
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.
programme.sub-title: The Strange Farm: The Anaïs Guillaume Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case
programme.desc: On September 12, 2013, Eric Mosser, a 45-year-old heating engineer, discovers his wife Isabelle lying in a pool of blood at their home in Illfurth, Alsace.
programme.sub-title: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy
programme.desc: On March 21th 1991, Pascale Escarfail, 19 years old, is discovered dead at her studio in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, she was raped then stabbed multiple times.
programme.sub-title: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Julein Thevenet Case
programme.desc: On January 27th 2014, in Somme-Suippe in the Marne, Sophie Thevenet discovers her dead husband's body in the garage.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Raphael Lomoro Case
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)
programme.desc: Dominique Aubry, a rich widow of 58, is found hanged on her barge in Neuilly. It appears that since the death of her husband on a trip to Mauritius, Dominique Aubry has been ailing.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Only DNA Can Say - Angélique Dumetz
programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.
programme.sub-title: Only DNA Can Say - Angélique Dumetz

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murderous Lovers - Anne Bardot
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of 4 years old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Evelyne Boucher Case
programme.desc: On December 9th 1987, the naked body of the young Evelyne Boucher is found near Avignon. An unprecedented investigation begins making headlines.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Killer Cop (Tavernier Case)
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente, are called to a fire in a large house in the village. They arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, Claude Tavernier, 83, lying in a large pool of blood.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Killer Cop (Tavernier Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Céline Marchand Case
programme.desc: On May 30th 2015 in Sorinières, Yann Machand reports his wife Céline Marchand missing.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 401
programme.desc: Vi møder perfektionisten Christina, der efter to kejsersnit har fået et grimt ar og en delle på maven, som hun eksperimenterer med at skjule ved at vikle maven ind i husholdningsfilm.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 903
programme.desc: Nanna har fået flere brystoperationer og korrektioner, men er nu efterladt med misformede, hårde bryster. Heidi kan grundet operationer ikke holde ud at hun selv eller andre ser hende nøgen.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 301
programme.desc: Fejlslagne plastikoperationer har givet fire kvinder ar på både krop og sjæl. Vi møder Jane, som har fået ødelagt sin karriere som dildosælger af, at hun ikke længere selv har lyst til sex på grund af sine grimme bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 807
programme.desc: I 2010 tog Tina til Thailand for at få udskiftet sine brystimplantater, men operationen gik ikke som forventet, og i dag står hun tilbage med smerter der hæmmer hende på dansegulvet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 803
programme.desc: Natasja er tidligere side-9-pige og model. I 2013 fik hun skiftet implantaterne i silikonebrysterne ud, men operationen gik ikke som planlagt, og som resultat har hun nu to meget forskellige bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 512
programme.desc: Nina arbejder som show-pige, og det påvirker derfor hendes arbejde meget, når hun skal fokusere på et rutsjende implantat og en grim kavalergang.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 309
programme.desc: Vi møder Ditte, der har brugt 120.000 kr. på at få lavet sine bryster større, og som i dag står tilbage med kæmpestore, men asymmetriske bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 502
programme.desc: Lenette har tabt sig 55 kilo og føler, at hun har for meget løs hud på mave, bryster og lår. Hun finder derfor en kirurg, foretager alle tre operationer, men det går ikke som planlagt.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 614
programme.desc: 24-årige Bettina har hele livet været ked af sin næse, der i folkeskolen har givet anledning til øgenavne som Pelikanen og H.C. Andersen.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 603
programme.desc: For tre år siden valgte Sarah at få foretaget en brystforstørrende operation i Polen, men efter indgrebet syntes hun, brysterne lignede to kaffeposer med implantater.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 608
programme.desc: I 2011 vælger Sabina at få lavet en brystforstørrende operation. Men allerede få dage efter indgrebet opdager hun, at brysterne hænger.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: Vi møder Connie, der ønskede sig naturlige bryster, men blev rådgivet af sin kirurg til at vælge de største implantater. Nu føler hun, at hun har fået lavet så store bryster, at folk tænker: ”..der kommer brysterne med Connie”

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 612
programme.desc: Efter et større vægttab får 25-årige Michele lavet en maveskindsoperation, men resultatet skuffer slemt, og Michele har fået store problemer med sin livskvalitet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 203
programme.desc: Mød Pia, der efter en brystforstørrende operation fik stafylokokker og måtte gå 6 måneder med kun ét implantat hun først fik ud, da hun fik blodforgiftning.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 610
programme.desc: Sportsglade Jeanette blev for 12 år siden inspireret af en trend i fitnesscenteret, hvor veninderne fik opereret deres bryster større. Modsat veninderne bliver hun ikke glad for sine nye store bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 403
programme.desc: Vi møder Charlotte, der har svært ved at få et forhold til en mand, fordi hun skammer sig over sine silikonebryster, og Katja, som kæmper med gamle tråde fra tidligere operationer i brysterne.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 507
programme.desc: For 10 år siden får Michelle fjernet en godartet cyste bag højre øje. Operationen medfører, at øjenlåget hænger løst nedover øjet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: Mød Louise, der brugte familiens penge på en brystoperation, der endte med at blive en traumatisk oplevelse for hende.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 509
programme.desc: Philip fik som 16-årig brækket næsen i en slåskamp og har siden forsøgt at få den pæn gennem en række operationer i udlandet. Alle operationerne er mislykkedes.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 101
programme.desc: I Mit plastikmareridt møder vi i aftenens program fire ofre for plastiskkirurgiske fejloperationer. Mille, der jagter drømmen om det perfekte, Joan, der føler, at hun har mistet sin femininitet.
